entries.390526498419bc42: The company manufactures and sells wheat flour and premix. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥103,600 million. Okumoto Seifun Co., Ltd., Kida Seifun Co., Ltd., Naigai Seifun Co., Ltd. and Central Seifun Co., Ltd. produce wheat flour, Showa Sangyo International Vietnam Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells premix in Vietnam, and Shosan Shoji Co., Ltd. sells the company's products. Breads for convenience stores are produced by Swing Bakery Co., Ltd., Gran Sol Bakery Co., Ltd., Garden Bakery Co., Ltd. and Tower Bakery Co., Ltd.
entries.4dd920b5da5cde2a: This business manufactures and sells food products such as wheat flour, edible oil and saccharified products. The three main categories are flour milling, oil processing and sugar products. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥271,828 million (down 0.6% year on year), the largest category of group revenue.

entries.73cbd1dd59ce23a1: This business sells compound feed and also handles livestock products such as eggs. Production of compound feed is outsourced, and Kyushu Showa Sangyo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells it in Kyushu. Showa Keiran Co., Ltd. and others sell eggs that have been washed and graded. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥58,740 million (up 4.6% year on year).
entries.838357c2f5ee92cf: This category is not included in reportable segments and includes warehousing (grain handling and storage), real estate (building leasing), plant factories, insurance agency, automobile leasing and transportation, among others. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,844 million (up 2.4% year on year).
